tldr: Mercury in Scorpio: the mind probes, detects, and refuses shallow answers.
body: With Mercury in Scorpio, communication is intense, private, and drawn toward what is hidden. You think best when you can investigate the motive beneath the statement.
gift: Research, psychological insight, strategic speech, and the courage to name what others avoid.
challenge: Suspicion, secrecy, cutting words, or using silence as control.
note: Authored from Marie Satori planet-through-sign material.
